description: Four roasted chicken drumsticks are arranged on a light green surface, each garnished with fresh rosemary sprigs and sprinkled with herbs. The drumsticks are golden brown, indicating a well-cooked and seasoned exterior. Surrounding the chicken are vibrant red cherry tomatoes, slices of bright yellow lemon, and scattered peppercorns, adding a pop of color and freshness to the composition. The arrangement is visually appealing, with the ingredients artistically placed to create a balanced and appetizing display. The overall presentation suggests a focus on fresh, flavorful ingredients, ideal for a culinary setting.
